fact: The Ghana Standards Authority (GSA), led by Director-General Prof. George Agyei, hosted a steering committee meeting at Standards Heights on 19 March 2026 on phase II of a metrology institute project with Germany's PTB; the document names no IT or data standard.

The Ghana Standards Authority Act, 2022 (Act 1078) was assented to and published in the Ghana Gazette on 30 June 2022; only citation and history metadata were captured, the operative text did not load, and it is amended by the Ghana Accreditation Service Act, 2023.

Communications Minister Samuel Nartey George said on 4 September 2026 that the Ghana Standards Authority, with the NCA and EPA, ensures cell sites comply with approved radiation and safety levels; no IT or data standard is named.
The GOGLA country brief states that the Ghana Standards Authority (GSA) is the national standards body in Ghana; it gives no date for this, so the document's published date of 2024-01-01 is used.
